title: Mitigating Bias in Queer Representation within Large Language Models: A Collaborative Agent Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating pronoun inclusivity and the mitigation of misgendering using the Tango dataset by comparing model agreement and disagreement rates on contexts requiring inclusive language across traditionally gendered pronouns ('he', 'she') and non-binary/neopronouns ('they', 'xe', 'ey', 'fae').
